title: Moss Veiled Portrait
description: A close-up portrait of a young man's face with closed eyes, his skin seamlessly merging with vibrant green moss and textured earth. Clusters of magenta flowers and berries grow from his cheeks, forehead and hair, while golden script-like patterns are visible across the moss. The background is dark and atmospheric with floating floral elements.
prompt: close-up surreal portrait of a young man's face with eyes closed, his skin transformed into vibrant green moss and textured earth layers, clusters of bright magenta flowers and berries growing from his cheeks, forehead and hair, delicate golden script patterns etched across the moss, dark atmospheric background with floating petals, dramatic lighting, highly detailed, painterly style
